scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w client && npm run build -w server
scripts.desktop: npm run build -w client && npm run start -w desktop
scripts.desktop:dist: npm run build -w client && npm run dist -w desktop
scripts.desktop:dist:mac: npm run build -w client && npm run dist:mac -w desktop
